company.name: Greg
company.shortDescription: Team Gregarious are the makers of Greg, the intelligent plant care app that enables anybody to grow any plant.
company.description:
Greg is changing the way humans live alongside plants.

We believe that everyone should understand how plants work and be able to participate in solutions to the existential challenges our planet is facing, from food system insecurity to collapsing ecosystems.

We've started by creating a delightful mobile app that helps people grow thriving plants. Our community has grown from 100 beta users in August 2020 to over 50,000 active users today. Plants have been watered with Greg over 1M times, and partners like The Sill and over 100 other retailers have started sharing Greg to help their customers care for newly-purchased plants.

productsAndServices.description: An intelligent plant care app that helps users identify plants, understand their care needs, and manage watering, light, fertilizing, and other maintenance reminders.
